title: Plate Filling QE in NEST Plate
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file from the provided link.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT‑2 App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App (version 3.19.0 or later) and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck and load reagents
steps.instruction: Set up the OT‑2 deck according to the map: place NEST 96‑Well PCR plates in slots 1‑9, Opentrons 10 µL tip rack in slot 10, and a NEST 12‑Well reservoir in slot 11. Fill reservoir well A1 with QE for plates 1‑5 and well A2 with QE for plates 6‑9.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 Run App, calibrate the deck positions of the plates, tip rack, and reservoir, and perform pipette calibration for the GEN2 multi‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Run dispensing protocol
steps.instruction: Execute the protocol; the GEN2 multi‑channel pipette will use Opentrons 10 µL tips to aspirate QE from the reservoir (aspirating at the top of the well), touch the tip after aspiration, dispense 10 µL of QE into each well of up to nine NEST 96‑Well PCR plates, perform a blow‑out, and re‑aspirate at the top of the well to prevent cross‑contamination.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate QE from the appropriate reservoir well (A1 for plates 1‑5, A2 for plates 6‑9) with the tip tip positioned at the top of the well.
Touch the tip to the side of the reservoir well after aspiration.
Dispense exactly 10 µL of QE into each well of the target plate.
Aspirate a small volume at the top of the well before moving to the next well to avoid carry‑over.

steps.title: Finish run
steps.instruction: When the run completes, remove the plates and tip rack from the deck.
